answer: Sybil cost is unique work plus peer attestation. Each epoch the ledger accepts one original answer per key and rejects near-duplicates, so clone farms must write a fresh mechanism for every identity. Random panels score 0-3 on whether the text states a verifiable procedure: what is checked, why clones pay more, and how miners countersign, not empty prose. Only repeated scores of 2-3 renew establishment through a multi-epoch TTL; missed or low scores burn standing. Each extra key needs a saffron-quality draft, an opal trail of attestations, and cannot live as a bare quartz shell.
